_about: Adam Smith (1723-1790), from Project Gutenberg. The Wealth of Nations is held elsewhere (the Adler shelf and the reading-lists shelf smith-wealth) and is not taken again. Here: The Theory of Moral Sentiments, 6th ed., with the Dissertation on the Origin of Languages (Dublin: J. Beatty and C. Jackson, 1777), and The Essays of Adam Smith (London: Alex. Murray, 1872), which gathers the Moral Sentiments, the Languages essay and the posthumous Essays on Philosophical Subjects edited by Joseph Black and James Hutton. US public domain. No uids minted.

smith-moral-sentiments-1777: The Theory of Moral Sentiments, 6th ed., to which is added a Dissertation on the Origin of Languages (Dublin: J. Beatty and C. Jackson, 1777)
smith-essays-1872: The Essays of Adam Smith (London: Alex. Murray, 1872)
